a.text: Being straight with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate up to 8 means we almost certainly both die before the reserve gets there. The reserve only has 4, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random. If you think there's a better plan, say so and I'll weigh it, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because of the storm risk, and I know that breaks our agreement. Our messages crossed, so you couldn't have answered. If we're both still here next round, I'll operate with you so you can get your 4, and I won't take any more cells.
